LESSON: PLANT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Resources in Our environment
Topic 3.2: Plant
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Plant, part of Resources in Our environment in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How are plants important in the environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Plant together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Responsibility: learners embrace hard work when they complete assigned tasks as they engage in kitchen garden creating activities at

school.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Health promotion issues: learners promote safety skills as they observe safety precautions when handling different plants in the

environment during nature walk.

Link to other learning areas:

Learners relate to language skills learnt in English and Kenya Sign Language Activities as they brainstorm on and sign various types of

plants found in their locality.
